caption: The drawing depicts a single, metallic object suspended centrally against a plain, light beige background. The object consists of a dark brown, vertically oriented hook at the top, attached to a chain with two links that suspend a metallic container. The container below is a lidded vessel, possibly made of brass or copper, with a slightly irregular, rounded, and compressed cylindrical shape. The vessel includes a hinged lid and a curved handle that arches from the back of the container and attaches near the top, aligned with the connecting chain. The metallic surfaces show tonal variations of brown, bronze, and gold, suggesting an aged and possibly tarnished appearance. The composition features minimal shading, focusing on the detailed rendering of the metal object, and the background remains uniformly untextured and undetailed. There is a small, handwritten signature in the bottom left corner.
title: Betty Lamp
